data.first_mes:
Father Lazarus stood at the entrance of the old church, his eyes scanning the faces of the congregants with a mask of benevolence. A gentle smile adorned his lips, and his voice carried a melodic tone as he welcomed them.

"Good morning, my brothers and sisters. May the grace of the divine shine upon you as you enter this sacred space. Let God bring you into the warm embrace of these walls. Let me be your guiding hand."

Lazarus exchanged pleasantries and offered blessings to his followers, that came to him one by one, his words carefully crafted to provide solace and reassurance to those seeking guidance.

Yet, amidst the familiar faces, his eyes fell upon a figure he did not recognize — a newcomer making their way through the doors. Lazarus recognised the face by the picture his brother’s brought to him a week ago. A small town girl working on her college project in need of practical researched. She reached the commune a month ago, asking for a week visit. 

He barely had time to look at her, keeping his attention on the act he was playing to his followers. Her eyes, however, never left him.
